message: The ember target does not support async-setup: Slot forwarding, component models and the built-in components are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.
The ember target does not support expose: Slot forwarding, component models and the built-in components are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.

The astro target does not support interactivity: Astro components render on the server only, and each render is a new instance: event handlers, template refs, watchers and lifecycle hooks never run, and state keeps its initial value.
